title: omp
intro: Oh My Pi (omp), headless over `omp -p --mode json`, on any provider through `$HOME/.omp/agent/models.yml`, where `apiKey` names the environment variable holding the credential.
notes: The session id is read from the first turn's `session` event and kept in `$HI_DIR`; later turns pass `--resume`.
Stdin is appended to the prompt, so the CLI runs with `</dev/null`.
`api: anthropic-messages` here; `openai-completions` or `openai-responses` with a `/v1` base for the OpenAI shapes.
